dedupe_keys.name: reperes de nivellement du canevas altimetrique de m2a

description: Repères de nivellement du canevas altimétrique de m2A is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. Sealed markers in a facade, enclosure wall or work of art, the altitude of which is precisely determined in the reference system NGF-IGN69. Data map: ( Leveling markers are used to carry out topographical work. They are also used for the construction of a work of art, a road or a building. Coverage: Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Levelling points of the altimeter canvas of m2A" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. Its keywords include canevas, territoire, altitude, geodesie, nivellement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-03-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
